use default
use IO.Std.read_line

verse(name: string) -> string is
    let lower = name.to_lower()
    let first = lower[0]
    let tail =
        if "aeiou".contains(first) then lower else lower.substring(1) fi

    let rhyme = (letter: char) =>
        if first == letter then tail else "{letter}{tail}" fi

    "{name}, {name}, bo-{rhyme('b')}\n"
    "Banana-fana fo-{rhyme('f')}\n"
    "Fee-fi-mo-{rhyme('m')}\n"
    "{name}!\n"
si

while let name = read_line() do
    write_line(verse(name.trim()))
